tasks.title: GL+month active rollups for Actual (DUB) and Budget
tasks.objective: Reduce both sides to one active row per (gl_code, month) BEFORE any join, so the later cross-object composition cannot fan out.
acceptance_criteria: a reproducible warehouse rollup reduces DUB actuals to (gl_code, month) as SUM(actual_net) over cost centres (WHERE plant='DUB'), and an active-budget rollup reduces the ACTIVE budget batch to (gl_code, month) as SUM(budget_amount)::numeric(18,2) with period aliased to month, each reflecting ONLY the active batch
the budget rollup preserves the set of cost_center (Budget Components) labels per (gl_code, month) key as informational (never a join key), and carries raw rollover_amount untouched with no measure

a demonstrated warehouse-DB test proves each rollup reflects only the active batch: a retained prior actuals/budget batch does not change the rollup, and a budget reload swaps the active batch without altering actuals

tasks.title: Closed, typed, code-composed Budget⋈Actual relation with two-sided scope
tasks.objective: Provide ONE governed financial gold relation that full-outer-joins the two GL+month rollups with zero-fill, serves every gold-object consumer, and enforces role-based access with the scope predicate inside both source CTEs.
acceptance_criteria: a single closed, typed code-composed financial relation full-outer-joins the two GL+month rollups on (gl_code, month) with COALESCE zero-fill (a Budget-only key and an Actual-only key both appear), replacing the SQL builder's multi-gold-object rejection; it lists every physical object in objectsTouched for the validator allow-list and provides relation semantics to freshness, dimension enumeration, RBAC scope validation and reconciliation

a governed-financial read action is required at the shared SelectionExecutor execution boundary together with the domain and Actual/Budget/% grants, and the row-scope predicate is injected INSIDE each source CTE before the join (Actual by plant, Budget by its trusted derived constant DUB); a denial case and a predicate-placement test are included
a demonstrated warehouse-DB test proves the composed relation zero-fills correctly and does NOT fan out: a GL with multiple actual cost centres does not repeat Budget, and totals are exact

tasks.title: Code-authored Actual / Budget / % measures over the composed relation
tasks.objective: Author the governed financial domain and its measures in code so report, drill-down and assistant share one definition; the LLM only selects measures.
acceptance_criteria: a code-authored financial DomainSpec and Actual (SUM(Debit-Credit)), Budget (SUM(budget_amount)) and % MeasureSpecs are registered in semanticLayer baseDomains over the composed relation; two-column expressions are code-authored (not the runtime builder), and the LLM/runtime never authors the SQL

% follows the full nil rule: 0/0 -> NA/blank; Actual>0,Budget=0 -> over-budget (no %); Actual<0,Budget=0 -> credit / negative actual (no %); i.e. no percentage for any non-zero Actual against zero Budget, with the positive/negative labels distinguished

tasks.title: Golden-answer fixtures (no fan-out) + provenance lineage
tasks.objective: Gate correctness with exact golden fixtures and make every governed number reproducible and explainable.
acceptance_criteria: a golden-answer reconciliation fixture asserts EXACT expected values for matched, Budget-only (zero-filled), Actual-only (zero-filled), duplicate/multi-cost-centre (no fan-out), reload/active-swap (answer unchanged, actuals untouched), and %-edge (0/0 NA, positive over-budget, negative credit/negative-actual) cases, as demonstrated host evidence (D-0008)

provenance for every governed number carries the measure definition + composed SQL PLUS active source batch ids keyed by (source, period), row-aligned source-presence (matched / budget-only / actual-only, or a set for aggregate rows), and a deterministic set of Budget-Components labels, all captured within the same composed query
